hooks.command: hook_input=$(cat); if echo "$hook_input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' > /dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; case $(uname) in Darwin) osascript -e 'display alert "Claude Code" message "Task completed"' ;; *) notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Task completed' ;; esac
case $(uname) in Darwin) osascript -e 'display alert "Claude Code" message "Claude needs your attention"' ;; *) notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Claude needs your attention' ;; esac
